name: topographical-disorientation-support-skill
description: Accommodation framework for developmental topographical disorientation (DTD, also called atopia): the lifelong, often familial inability to form a cognitive map, with unreliable binding between direction words and physical directions. Rewrites directions into landmark form, builds landmark route scripts from OpenStreetMap data, checks wayfinding content, and drafts accommodation documents for US, French, and Spanish contexts, with an evidence grade on every recommendation.
